worked_solution:
We know that $a⊥b$ ($a$ and $b$ are perpendicular) if and only if $a\cdot b=0.$

Computing the dot product, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & ={a}_{x}\cdot {b}_{x}+{a}_{y}\cdot {b}_{y} \\  & =2{x}^{2}\cdot 8+(-4)\cdot 4 \\  & =16{x}^{2}-16.\end{aligned}
$$

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\cdot b & =0 \\ 16{x}^{2}-16 & =0 \\ 16{x}^{2} & =16 \\ {x}^{2} & =1 \\ x & =\pm 1.\end{aligned}
$$

We disregard the negative solution since we are told that $x>0.$ Therefore, $x=1.$
